subject.title: feat: agent_settled extension event for true session idle

question: Should `agent_settled` be accepted as a stable writable plugin-SDK lifecycle event after its dispatch is made session-lock-safe, or should the public contract be deferred until a broader settlement API is designed?
rationale: This PR adds a new public extension event whose idle semantics and handler capabilities become a durable plugin contract; the supplied context has no maintainer decision resolving that API direction.

options.title: Accept the narrow event safely
options.body: Keep the additive event, route it through the existing write-lock dispatch path, and add embedded-session regression coverage for writable handlers.

options.title: Defer the public contract
options.body: Do not add the SDK overload until maintainers choose a broader settlement model and explicitly define what handlers may safely do.

recommendation.title: Accept the narrow event safely
recommendation.body: Keep the additive event, route it through the existing write-lock dispatch path, and add embedded-session regression coverage for writable handlers.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the proposed public event and are the only concrete routing candidate available from the supplied item provenance.
